title: Tamil Nadu Politics – Evening Brief – 1 November 2026
headline: Pudukottai brought under heavy security cover for CM’s visit on Monday

top_developments.headline: Pudukottai brought under heavy security cover for CM’s visit on Monday
top_developments.summary: PUDUKOTTAI Pudukottai has been brought under a heavy security cover as Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay is to visit the town on Monday to participate in a government function. Vijay’s maiden visit to Pudukottai after becoming the Chief Minister. Separate security schemes have been drafted by the Tiruchi City Police, Tiruchi Rural Police, and the Pudukottai district police as the Chief Minister is to reach Pudukottai by road from the Tiruchi International Airport. Additional strength has been drawn from other districts to tighten security in and around Pudukottai.

sources.title: Postponement of college exam for CM’s visit in Pudukottai triggers row
sources.snippet: PUDUKOTTAI With Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay scheduled to visit Pudukottai on November 2, to inaugurate the new bus stand and distribute welfare measure, semester examinations scheduled for the day at the Kalaignar Karunanidhi Government Arts College for Women, an autonomous institution in the town, has been postponed, triggering a row. The examinations in the college started on October 30 and are to conclude on November 19.

sources.title: "My good time joined Thalapathy" - Minister KA Sengottaiyan
sources.snippet: Minister Sengottaiyan said that various welfare schemes including self-help group schemes for women are going to be provided at a government function in Erode Perundurai on Monday in which Chief Minister Vijay will participate. Speaking at the 25th anniversary function of the Vijayamangalam Private Education Group, Revenue Minister Sengottaiyan jokingly remarked, "My good times were associated with Thalapathy. Otherwise, I would be sitting in the third row staring at the stage."

top_developments.headline: Tamil Nadu to set up 26 POCSO Act courts and four NDPS courts
top_developments.summary: Chennai Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay has ordered the establishment of 26 courts under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012, and four courts under the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985, to expedite the trial of cases registered under these laws. A State government press release issued on Sunday (November 1, 2026) said during a review meeting on cases registered under the POCSO Act, the Chief Minister had stressed the need to ensure justice for victims by speeding up trials.

sources.title: Govt mulls medical college at Tambaram hospital; Nalam AI to ease medicine collection at government hospitals
sources.snippet: The Tamil Nadu government is considering upgrading the Tambaram District Government Hospital into a medical college, while exploring the expansion of its Nalam AI digital health platform to enable patients to schedule medicine collection and avoid long queues at government hospitals, Health and Family Welfare Minister K G Arunraj said on Sunday..Talking to reporters at airport here, the Minister said the proposal to establish a medical college at Tambaram was under consideration and would be discussed with Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay before a formal announcement.Addressing complaints about prolonged waiting times at hospital...

sources.snippet: The Tamil Nadu government has issued an ordinance to set up 30 new special courts to ensure speedy justice for sexual crimes against women and children and to create a drug-free Tamil Nadu. The Chief Minister held a detailed review meeting to speed up investigation and conviction of pending cases under the POCSO Act, which protects children from sexual offences. At that time, Chief Minister Vijay had ordered to take necessary steps to speed up the investigation of sex crime cases. top_developments.headline: President Droupadi Murmu , PM Modi, CM Vijay greet people on Tamil Nadu Day fete
top_developments.summary: President Droupadi Murmu, Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar and Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay on Sunday greeted the people of the State on the occasion of Tamil Nadu Day, acknowledging the State’s contribution to the country’s growth and underscoring the importance of preserving its linguistic, cultural and historical identity..In her message, President Murmu extended greetings to the people of 13 States and Union Territories marking their Formation Day, including Tamil Nadu. top_developments.headline: How significant is the TVK-led regime’s move to hold Social Justice Survey? Explained
top_developments.summary: The feature of an ‘open column’, where respondents can state their caste during the second phase of the Census, to be carried out in most parts of the country during February next year, has forced many parties and other stakeholders to express concerns over the utility of the whole exercise.

top_developments.headline: VCK functionary hacked to death in TN's Thoothukudi
top_developments.summary: TUTICORIN (TN): A 40-year-old VCK functionary was hacked to death by an unidentified gang at a petrol bunk here on Sunday morning, police said..The incident triggered protests and tension in the area.The deceased was identified as Balamurugan, a resident of Sottaiyan Thoppu under the Mappillaiurani village panchayat.Police said he operated a vegetable shop and also worked as a van driver.After returning from the market and unloading vegetables at his shop, Balamurugan went to a fuel outlet on Davispuram Road to refuel his two-wheeler.

top_developments.summary: DMK General Secretary Duraimurugan has been a dream come true for MGR's regime, party leader M.K.Stalin has said. The marriage ceremony of DMK general secretary and former minister Duraimurugan's granddaughter, Kathir Anand MP's daughter Sentamarai and businessman and film producer Thipakkudi Ravi Kannan's son Deepak was held in Chennai. DMK President Stalin, Deputy General Secretary Kanimozhi, Leader of Opposition Udayanidhi and others congratulated the bride and groom. Speaking then, M.K.Stalin said that Duraimurugan is an example of how one should be in public life...

- **Chennai city to get 36 new parks and 11 playgrounds:** Chennai The Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC) will develop 36 new parks at an estimated cost of ₹34.45 crore and 11 new playgrounds at ₹9.52 crore in the first phase of the Chief Minister’s Integrated Urban Development Mission (CMIUDM), 2026–2031. CM announces ₹1,850-cr for road repairs in Chennai and other urban areas CM announces ₹1,850-cr for road repairs in Chennai and other urban areas CM announces ₹1,850-cr for road repairs in Chennai and other urban areas storyline 1 The GCC is currently undertaking the tendering process for the parks and playgrounds. ([The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/chennai/chennai-city-to-get-36-new-parks-and-11-playgrounds/article71652434.ece))
- **POCSO accused auto driver who went missing from hospital arrested in Chennai:** A 61-year-old auto-rickshaw driver, accused of sexually harassing an eight-year-old girl, was arrested after he went missing from a government hospital, Greater Chennai Police said on Sunday..The man was accused of sexually harassing the girl while she was travelling in his auto-rickshaw to school on October 30.Following the alleged incident, the girl’s parents and relatives assaulted the driver, leaving him with injuries to his head and back, police said.He was rescued by his son and admitted to the Periyar Nagar Government Hospital. ([DT Next](https://www.dtnext.in/news/tamilnadu/pocso-accused-auto-driver-who-went-missing-from-hospital-arrested-in-chennai))
- **Cramped truck, no food or water: 25 cattle being taken to Keralam for slaughter rescued:** On Saturday, police and animal welfare activists rescued 25 cattle from a cramped truck near Maraimalai Nagar. The animals were being transported to Keralam for slaughter without appropriate documentation or care. Activist Sai Vignesh observed the cramped conditions and notified the authorities about the situation. After the police raided the truck, the cattle were sent to a government goshala for urgent care. ([The Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/cramped-truck-no-food-or-water-25-cattle-being-taken-to-keralam-for-slaughter-rescued/articleshow/135426110.cms))

- **Seven Rameswaram fishermen detained by Sri Lankan Navy near Katchatheevu islet:** RAMESWARAM In a fresh incident, seven fishermen from Rameswaram and Thangachimadam in the Ramanathapuram district were arrested on charges of poaching in international waters by Sri Lankan Navy personnel in the early hours of Sunday (November 1, 2026). According to Tamil Nadu Fisheries Department officials, Sri Lankan Navy personnel apprehended seven fishermen who were fishing between the Katchatheevu islet and Mannar North at around 1 a.m. on Sunday (November 1, 2026). They were taken, along with the trawler, to a naval port in the island nation. ([The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/seven-rameswaram-fishermen-detained-by-sri-lankan-navy-near-katchatheevu-islet/article71652111.ece))
- **Tasmac employees strike across Tamil Nadu: Demand scrapping of new procedure:** Tasmac shops will make it mandatory to scan empty bottles while returning them, and the new procedure will allow buyers of liquor above Rs 1,000 to pay through UPI from today. But the employees allege that the scheme has been implemented without increasing the number of sales counters and without adequate improvements. After this, they participated in protests across the state. More than 150 Tasmac workers in Madurai district gathered at the district collector's office today without opening their shops, demanding to abandon the system of scanning empty bottles... ([News18 Tamil Nadu](https://tamil.news18.com/tamil-nadu/tasmac-employees-strike-across-tamilnadu-against-bottle-scanning-and-upi-payment-sal-2243774.html))
- **"He said he would give a bribe of Rs. 5 crore" - Minister Rajmohan's 'shock' information at the Tamil Nadu Day function!:** Tamil Development Minister Rajmohan has announced that one day a week Traditional Dress Day will be observed in government offices in Tamil Nadu. Ministers Anand, Aadhav Arjuna, Rajmohan, Vanniarasu and others participated in the Tamil Nadu Day function held in Egmore, Chennai. Speaking then, Minister Rajmohan assured that the World Tamil Conference will be held again. Then he said, "Give me the post of President of the Music, Music and Drama Council. I will give Rs 5 crore to Minister Rajmohan. Even if I give Rs 500 crore, the Chief Minister will not give responsibility to someone who is not suitable. ([News18 Tamil Nadu](https://tamil.news18.com/tamil-nadu/he-offered-a-bribe-of-rs-5-crore-minister-rajmohan-reveals-a-shocking-detail-at-the-tamil-nadu-day-event-nw-mma-ws-bl-2243782.html))
- **People boycotted the village council meeting in Kunichi panchayat! The struggle to hand over the ration card:** Tirupattur: In Kunichi panchayat, locals boycotted the village council meeting to protest against the setting up of cremation grounds for Christian and Muslim community members from the outlying areas. They also handed over ration cards and held a protest. There was a lot of commotion in the village council meeting held in Kunichi panchayat of Tirupathur district when people suddenly walked out and started protesting. About 500 families are living in Kunichi and its surrounding areas. The area has already been earmarked for various government purposes... ([Oneindia Tamil](https://tamil.oneindia.com/news/tamilnadu/kunichi-residents-boycott-gram-sabha-over-burial-ground-issue-842235.html))

On the occasion of Pasumbon Muthuramalingath Devar Jayanti and Guru Puja at the memorial in Pasumbon, Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan and Tamil Nadu Governor R.V. Arlekar paid homage today. Following this program, Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan visited Madurai Meenakshi Amman Temple. Later at Madurai Meenakshi Amman Temple, Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan, Governor R.V. Arlekar had darshan of Sami. What is the reason for power cut in Madurai Meenakshi Amman Temple? ([News18 Tamil Nadu](https://tamil.news18.com/tamil-nadu/meenakshi-temple-power-outage-while-vice-president-darshan-engineer-suspended-nw-mma-ws-bl-2243604.html))
- **"Should be ensured to pay fair wages to temple workers" - High Court Madurai Session:** The Madurai bench of the High Court has directed the charity department to ensure that every employee working in public temples in Tamil Nadu is paid the necessary wages to lead a dignified life. Judges GR Swaminathan and Murugan opined that even though the legal minimum wage is on the one hand, the welfare department has not made any effort to improve the condition of the employees. ([Polimer News](https://www.polimernews.com/tamilnadunews/temple-employees-fair-wages-madurai-high-court-bench-12773070))
- **New committee to manage Chidambaram Nataraja temple: 3 questions asked by court - answers:** The Madras High Court has ordered on October 30 to set up an administrative committee headed by retired judges to streamline the administration of the Chidambaram Nataraja temple.
